text:
alex: heads up — multiple customer pages didn't reach on-call for the last 2m, seeing notify-bridge errors "header decode failed" in logs. paging gateway returning 400 from pager-proxy. @oncall-ryan can you take?

incident-bot: [ALERT] 1799012345 - notify-bridge: header_decode_error. paging suppressed (3/3) :warning:

maya: same here, EU customers reported missed SMS and delayed p60 pages, dashboard: https://dash.re/alerts/ABC-123 :frowning:

oncall-ryan: I'm on it. pulling logs now. quick grep:
```
2026-03-17T12:34:10Z notify-bridge ERROR header decode failed: invalid base64 padding
2026-03-17T12:34:11Z pager-proxy WARN upstream 400 bad-request
```
looks like an encoding/linebreak issue from inbound webhook. will try failover to backup-relay.

sara: if you need quick mitigation, run `kubectl scale deployment/notify-relay-backup --replicas=1 -n prod` and flip traffic: `curl -X POST https://ctl.re/redwood/relay/switch -d '{"to":"backup"}'`. runbook: <https://runbook.re/notify-bridge-failover> :cop: 

oncall-ryan: scaled backup, initiating switch now. ran `curl https://ctl.re/redwood/relay/switch -d '{"to":"backup"}'` — response 200. monitoring pages. :rocket:

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step executed by ryan: failover initiated. Expect pages to resume within 30s. If not, escalate to infra-right-now.

maya: pages picked up after ~20s, customers confirming delivery. monitoring for regressions. :thumbsup:

alex: good catch. please file a follow-up to fix header parsing and add a test for padded base64/newlines. assign to eng-infra and loop in @eng-security for header sanitization guidance.

oncall-ryan: opening incident ticket INC-7890: https://issues.re/INC-7890 — including logs + mitigation steps. keeping the channel open for postmortem notes.

incident-bot: Incident INC-7890 created and linked. Paging restored. Incident channel will remain open for 2h for postmortem and impact assessment.
